scope: Local authored credentials and owned HTTP/native child controls; no actual provider, model or Docker effects.

cases.expected: Existing private-file composition still succeeds; a nonprivate file, symlink, duplicate field or malformed file refuses without fallback.
A trusted exact environment configuration accepts an operator-selected valid name and passes only its in-memory credential to the existing client.
Missing, empty, whitespace, control, non-ASCII or oversized environment values refuse with generic diagnostics and no secret text.
Malformed or non-string environment names refuse before any client or file access.
Mixed file/environment, unknown keys, incomplete source, duplicate JSON keys and inline credentials refuse; neither source silently falls back.
Wrong viewer, workspace, team ID, team key or project refuses through the real client identity checks.
Changed environment credential after binding refuses before another request; missing selected credentials do not consult conventional names.
Real local session setup and service reload retain the environment source selection, verify the existing grant and persist no secret in config, databases, capability or diagnostics.
Model-facing schemas reject credential selection and changed sealed config refuses before model-facing effects.
Both native host environments omit selected and unrelated parent secrets; an owned Python child through the actual relay confirms isolation, with no model CLI invocation.
